name: Moshi Onna no Ko ni Nattara Nani kara Yaru ka
original_name: もし女の子になったらナニからやるか
source:
One day main character awakens in the body of a girl. He is puzzled, but diligently explores his new body capabilities.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-september-2005-gunjou-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
某天，主人公醒来后发现自己变成了女孩。他虽然困惑不解，却仍认真探索起这副新身体的种种可能。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-september-2005-gunjou-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
